import json, os, subprocess, sys
M = "docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation"
P = M + "/PROGRESS.md"
A = M + "/progress-archive/2026-10-19.md"
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git"] + list(a), check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
if not os.path.isfile(A):
    sys.exit("missing " + A)
add = git("log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "--", A).split()
assert len(add) == 1, add
ch = sorted(x for x in git("diff", "--no-renames", "--name-status", add[0] + "^", add[0], "--", M).splitlines() if x)
assert ch == ["A\t" + A, "M\t" + P], ch
old = git("show", add[0] + "^:" + P)
new = open(P, encoding="utf-8").read()
arch = open(A, encoding="utf-8").read()
block = old[old.index("\n## ") + 1:].rstrip("\n")
assert block in arch, "archive does not hold the old sections verbatim"
lines = new.splitlines()
assert lines[0].startswith("> **FROZEN**") and "2B" in lines[0] and "generated" in lines[0], lines[0]
assert len(lines) <= 40, "PROGRESS.md has %d lines" % len(lines)
for l in block.splitlines():
    assert len(l) <= 40 or l not in lines, "stale line kept: " + l[:60]
assert "agy/claude-opus" not in new, "stale brain"
heads = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("## Current status")]
assert len(heads) == 1, heads
i = heads[0]
j = next((k for k in range(i + 1, len(lines)) if lines[k].startswith("## ")), len(lines))
sec = "\n".join(lines[i:j])
meta = dict(l.split(": ", 1) for l in open(M + "/GOAL.md", encoding="utf-8").read().split("---")[1].strip().splitlines() if ": " in l)
for k in ("status", "owner"):
    assert k + ": " + meta[k] in sec, k
fleet = json.load(open(M + "/fleet.json", encoding="utf-8"))
for name, seat in sorted(fleet["seats"].items()):
    r = seat["approved_resolution"]
    want = "%s=%s/%s/%s/%s" % (name, r["provider"], r["model"], r["effort"], r["speed"])
    assert want in sec, want
b = fleet["seats"]["brain"]["approved_resolution"]
want = "brain = %s/%s, effort %s" % (b["provider"], b["model"], b["effort"])
assert want in sec, want
assert "Front Desk = Sonnet 5.5" in sec, "Front Desk"
feats = json.load(open(M + "/features.json", encoding="utf-8"))["features"]
acc = [f["id"] for f in feats if f["passes"] is True]
opn = [f["id"] for f in feats if f["passes"] is not True]
want = "accepted (passes: true): %s (%d of %d)" % (", ".join(acc), len(acc), len(feats))
assert want in sec, want
want = "open (passes: false): " + (", ".join(opn) if opn else "none")
assert want in sec, want
assert "Gate 2: passed" in sec, "Gate 2"
assert "released as 3.1.0 (merge commit f931ba5, tag v3.1.0" in sec, "release"
assert git("rev-parse", "v3.1.0^{commit}").startswith("f931ba5"), "tag"
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(M + "/routing-data.jsonl", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
oc = {}
for r in rows:
    if r.get("outcome"):
        oc[r["outcome"]] = oc.get(r["outcome"], 0) + 1
want = "routing-data.jsonl: %d rows, %d with an outcome: %s" % (len(rows), sum(oc.values()), ", ".join("%s %d" % kv for kv in sorted(oc.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))))
assert want in sec, want
for n in sorted(os.listdir(M + "/progress-archive")):
    assert "progress-archive/" + n in sec, n
print("ok")
